name: 经济补偿 (economic compensation on termination)
description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage over the 12 months before termination. Service is measured from the contract start through the incurred date: a full year pays one month, six months or more pays one, and any shorter part pays half. A wage above 3× the local monthly average pays at that figure for at most 12 years (劳动合同法 第四十七条); any other wage pays in full for all its years.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十六条、第四十七条; 实施条例 第二十七条: 每满一年一个月工资, 六个月以上不满一年按一年, 不满六个月半个月; 高于当地上年度职工月平均工资三倍的按三倍, 年限最高12年.

name: 代通知金 (one month's wage in lieu of notice)
description: The entry quantity is the employee's wage for the previous month, paid instead of 30 days' notice.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十条; 实施条例 第二十条: 额外支付一个月工资, 按劳动者上一个月的工资标准确定.

name: 全年一次性奖金 (annual one-time bonus)
description: The entry quantity is the annual one-time bonus awarded for the year. By default it joins cumulative comprehensive income. With the employee election `annual_bonus_separate` it stays out of that base and IIT_ANNUAL_BONUS taxes it alone. One bonus a year: pay anything else as BONUS.

references.title: 国税发〔2005〕9号 第一条; 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号: 全年一次性奖金可单独计税, 至2027-12-31.
Calculation note: Method B is implemented; Method A is available under 财税〔2018〕164号 and 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号 (extended to 2027-12-31) but is not modelled by this catalogue.

name: 奖金 (other bonus)
description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid with the month.

references.title: 国家统计局《关于工资总额组成的规定》第七条; 个人所得税法 第二条: 奖金属于工资、薪金所得.

name: 赔偿经济损失扣款 (deduction for damage the employee caused)
description: The entry quantity is the assessed economic loss. The deduction is capped at 20% of the contract monthly wage and must leave the local minimum wage (工资支付暂行规定 第十六条).

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第十六条: 每月扣除不超过当月工资20%, 且扣除后不低于当地最低工资; 上海 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 第二十二条 (2026-08-01起).

name: 违法解除赔偿金 (2N, unlawful termination)
description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage. Compensation is twice the 经济补偿 count over the whole period of service (劳动合同法 第八十七条), with the 3× wage and 12-year cap of 第四十七条 where the wage is above it.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第四十八条、第八十七条; 实施条例 第二十五条: 按经济补偿标准的二倍支付, 不再支付经济补偿.

name: 生育津贴代发 (fund maternity allowance paid through the employer)
description: The entry quantity is the maternity allowance the fund pays through the employer. Female employees only.

references.title: 财税〔2008〕8号: 生育津贴、生育医疗费免征个人所得税.

name: 股权激励所得 (stock options, restricted shares)
description: The entry quantity is the value of the equity incentive. It is taxable under the separate equity method, not monthly cumulative withholding, and is not paid in cash; the catalogue therefore records the value with no pay line and no monthly IIT base.

references.title: 财税〔2018〕164号 二(一); 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第25号: 股权激励单独适用综合所得税率表, 至2027-12-31.

name: 提前退休一次性补贴 (early-retirement lump sum)
description: The entry quantity is the lump sum paid on early retirement.

references.title: 财税〔2018〕164号 五(二): 提前退休一次性补贴按至法定退休年龄实际年度数分摊, 单独适用综合所得税率表.

name: 欠薪加付赔偿金 (labour-bureau ordered arrears penalty)
description: The entry quantity is the assessed additional compensation the labour bureau ordered: 50% to 100% of the unpaid sum (劳动合同法 第八十五条).

references.title: 劳动合同法 第八十五条: 逾期不支付, 按应付金额50%以上100%以下加付赔偿金.

name: 一次性伤残就业补助金 (grades 5–10, months by city)
description: The entry quantity is the one-off disability subsidy the authority assesses.

references.title: 工伤保险条例 第三十六条、第三十七条; 沪府令第93号 第四十条、第四十一条 (18/15/12/9/6/3个月, 临近退休每年减20%); 云政发〔2011〕255号 第三十六至三十八条 (33/29/22/18/13/7个月).

name: 生育津贴差额补足 (maternity top-up)
description: The entry quantity is the shortfall between the pre-leave wage and the maternity allowance received. Female employees only.

references.title: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第八条; 妇女权益保障法 第四十八条; 沪府发〔2013〕5号: 生育津贴低于产假前工资的差额由单位补足.

name: 内部退养一次性补贴 (internal-retirement lump sum)
description: The entry quantity is the lump sum paid on internal retirement.

references.title: 财税〔2018〕164号 五(三); 国税发〔1999〕58号: 内部退养一次性补贴按至法定退休年龄月份平均, 与当月工资合并确定税率.

name: 竞业限制经济补偿 (non-compete compensation, monthly after exit)
description: The entry quantity is the monthly non-compete compensation. It is payable only after the contract ends and for at most two years.

references.title: 劳动合同法 第二十三条、第二十四条; 法释〔2020〕26号 第三十六条: 竞业限制期限不超过二年, 未约定补偿的按前十二个月平均工资30%按月支付.

name: 伤残津贴 (grade 5–6, employer-paid monthly)
description: The entry quantity is the monthly disability allowance the employer assesses.

references.title: 工伤保险条例 第三十六条第一款第(二)项: 五级70%、六级60%, 低于当地最低工资标准的补足差额.

name: Statutory refund

references.title: A statutory correction is an adhoc entry on this item: the item is the correction, so no reversal is needed. A year that comes out overpaid raises an obligation for the HR controller to enter it.

description: Tax or a contribution overpaid, paid back to the employee. The entry quantity is the refund; the statutory schemes are not re-run.
